verdict.rationale: Public-code matching and license referencing is a fair review-safety axis for an AI coding agent, but the evidence pack never mentions OpenCode detecting matches to public code or surfacing license references for generated code. The ability to log in with a GitHub Copilot account only selects a model provider. The read-only plan agent and the permission controls are adjacent review features, not code-referencing.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
